paragraphs: Adobe's mission is to empower everyone to create. We build innovative platforms and tools that unleash creativity, productivity and personalized customer experiences. For over four decades, our innovations have transformed how people everywhere engage across all types of media. Adobe's solutions are the foundation of digital experiences, starting with the first creative spark, to the creation and development of all content and media, to the personalized delivery across every channel.

Our focus revolves around serving our customer audiences: business professionals, consumers, creators, creative professionals and marketing professionals. The massive opportunity and evolving role of creativity across roles and industries have driven Adobe's growth over the past four decades and are expected to continue to drive our growth going forward as we evolve our solutions and routes to market to anticipate the growing needs of our customers. In the artificial intelligence ("AI") era, we are harnessing the power of AI across our solutions by bringing together our commercially safe first-party and leading partner AI models best suited for the job; deploying conversational and agentic capabilities across offerings; ensuring ubiquity on all surfaces; delivering trusted and secure solutions; and expanding our global presence.

Adobe's value proposition is to empower creative expression across multiple media types and channels, at scale, in a collaborative and secure environment, with an end-to-end integrated platform spanning ideation, creation, production and activation. We power the entire content workflow with Adobe's AI platform, which offers customers brand safety, compliance, intellectual property protection, and reliability.

Adobe's strategy is to empower our customer audiences—business professionals, consumers, creators, creative professionals and marketing professionals—to be more creative, productive and successful. Underpinning our customer-focused solutions is our AI strategy and Adobe's AI platform. As a technology leader that unleashes creativity, productivity and customer experience orchestration, we deliver end-to-end professional creative and marketing solutions. We support our customers to transform the way they connect with their customers and bring creativity and marketing together in new and powerful ways through a connected ecosystem of tools, agents and workflows. We are scaling differentiated digital and enterprise routes to market and automated workflows to expand our brand value and global reach.

We drive our strategy through customer-specific product innovation and go-to-market motions focused on two customer groups: Business Professionals & Consumers and Creative & Marketing Professionals. We continue to focus on several key

growth drivers among our customer groups. This includes expanding relationships and engagement with existing customers, driving new customer adoption, delivering value-driven and innovative solutions in new categories across desktop, web and mobile, and increasing our geographic reach. We continue to scale our digital and enterprise routes to market as well as our extensive partner ecosystem to expand our addressable market and deliver on our strategy.

Creativity and productivity are merging and changing how everyone communicates digitally. Business professionals and consumers seek intuitive, all-in-one solutions that seamlessly integrate creativity and productivity across web and mobile. They require tools to digest and gain insights from vast amounts of information and data. They value ease of use, enabled by freemium models that provide accessible entry points to powerful tools that span document consumption and content creation. AI-powered features and conversational interfaces are increasingly replacing traditional templates, offering dynamic and personalized workflows that enhance efficiency.

For Business Professionals & Consumers, we are democratizing productivity and creativity with AI-driven, quick and easy applications ("apps") that enable users to be creative and productive whether consuming or generating content across multiple media types and channels. With Acrobat Studio, which brings together Adobe Acrobat and Express to deliver more product value, we are evolving Acrobat from a leading document productivity app to an integrated destination for people to get insights faster, create standout content and collaborate more seamlessly. Our Acrobat solutions, from our freemium Acrobat Reader to Acrobat AI Assistant to our AI-powered productivity and creativity destination, Acrobat Studio, facilitate frictionless onboarding and scaled reach in serving the billions of potential users in this customer group.

Creators and creative professionals need AI-driven solutions that provide power and precision from ideation and creation to production and delivery. They want a powerful destination for creative expression and access to leading AI models. They require seamless collaboration capabilities, powerful ideation tools, conversational and agentic AI solutions and flexible access to web, mobile, and desktop applications to meet the growing demand for high-quality, personalized content in a fast-paced digital economy.

As AI fundamentally transforms content production, distribution and monetization, our solutions accelerate creative expression for creators and creative professionals and enable anyone to create by using the AI functionality infused in our flagship creative applications as well as our AI-first solutions. We offer an end-to-end, ideation-to-creation platform powered by our commercially safe Firefly models and an expansive partner model ecosystem, offering customers choice and flexibility without the friction of switching between workflows and platforms.

Marketing professionals require AI-driven solutions that enable them to create, manage and optimize personalized digital experiences at scale and to enhance brand visibility across the content supply chain. They need agility, self-service capabilities, and integrated workflows to collaborate effectively with creative teams and agencies and meet the increasing demand for compelling content.

For marketing professionals, we unify creative production and marketing execution with comprehensive content supply chain solutions that deliver end-to-end customer experience orchestration solutions, automate workflows and personalize experiences and engagement at scale across channels. Centered around Adobe Experience Platform and apps and Adobe GenStudio, our offerings streamline the content supply chain and deliver agile, self-service capabilities and integrated workflows to collaborate effectively and efficiently produce high volumes of on-brand, personalized content to strengthen brand visibility. Our competitive differentiation comes from the increased value we provide customers by integrating the Adobe Experience Platform with our comprehensive set of solutions and embedding AI into our portfolio of solutions, such as Adobe Experience Platform AI Assistant. Adobe Experience Platform is a customer data platform that serves as a foundation in enterprises for digital customer engagement and brings together AI-powered apps and agents to efficiently drive engagement and loyalty. Through AI-powered features and AI agents, our solutions enable businesses to provide real-time orchestration of customer journeys and help marketers deliver impactful, data-driven campaigns while optimizing return on investment. Our innovations empower our customers to use their first-party customer data and deliver more relevant, high-impact advertising experiences rooted in direct consumer and business relationships.

Creative and marketing professionals have increasingly interconnected objectives and workflows in the content lifecycle. Creative professionals produce high-quality content, while marketing professionals leverage this content to deliver personalized, data-driven digital experiences at scale. Adobe's integrated solutions, such as GenStudio and Firefly Services, bridge the gap between content creation and marketing execution, enabling seamless collaboration and efficiency across these roles. This unified approach reflects Adobe's strategy to address the entire content lifecycle—from ideation to activation—ensuring alignment, scalability, and value for both creative and marketing functions.

AI represents a generational opportunity to serve an increasingly large and diverse customer universe. Adobe's approach to AI is rooted in the belief that creativity is a uniquely human trait – and that AI has the power to assist and amplify human ingenuity and enhance productivity. Adobe's AI leadership builds on our expertise across core creative categories like imaging, design, illustration and video as well as digital documents and digital experiences. Over the past several years, we have incorporated AI into our solutions and delivered hundreds of AI capabilities to enable customers to create, work and collaborate more efficiently. To address our customers' need for a holistic approach for their productivity, creativity and marketing needs, Adobe's strategy infuses AI across our apps, embeds purpose-built agents in our applications, provides choice of models and harnesses our unique data assets to deliver comprehensive and easy-to-use solutions.

headings: Risks Related to Our Ability to Grow Our Business
We may be unsuccessful at innovating in response to rapid technological or industry changes to meet customer needs, which could cause our business and financial results to suffer materially.
We participate in rapidly evolving and intensely competitive markets, and, if we do not compete effectively, our business and financial results could materially suffer.
Issues relating to the development and use of AI in our solutions may result in reputational harm, liability and adverse business and financial results.
If our reputation or our brands are damaged, our business and financial results may be adversely affected.
We may not realize the anticipated benefits of acquisitions, investments or other strategic transactions, and they may disrupt our business and adversely affect our business and financial results.
Risks Related to the Operation of Our Business
If we are unable to recruit and retain key personnel, our business may be harmed, and our hybrid work model may present challenges, which could adversely impact our business.
Security incidents, improper access to or disclosure of our customers' data or other cybersecurity incidents may harm our reputation and materially and adversely affect our business.
We face various risks associated with operating as a multinational corporation, and global adverse economic and geopolitical conditions may harm our business and financial condition.
Some of our enterprise solutions have extended and complex sales cycles, which may increase our costs and make our sales cycles unpredictable.
Risks Related to Laws and Regulations
We are subject to risks associated with compliance with laws and regulations globally, which may harm our business.
Increasing regulatory focus on privacy and security issues and expanding laws and regulatory requirements could impact our business models and expose us to increased liability.

Our intellectual property portfolio is a valuable asset and we may not be able to protect our intellectual property rights, including our source code, from infringement or unauthorized copying, use or disclosure.
Changes in tax rules and regulations or interpretations thereof may adversely affect our effective tax rates.
Contracting with government entities exposes us to additional risks inherent in the government procurement process.
paragraphs: As previously discussed, our actual results could differ materially from our forward-looking statements. Below we discuss some of the factors that could cause these differences. The occurrence of these and many other factors described in this report, and factors that we do not presently know or that we currently believe to be immaterial, could materially and adversely affect our operations, performance and financial condition. Many factors affect more than one category and the factors are not in order of significance or probability of occurrence because they have been grouped by categories.

We operate in rapidly evolving industries and expect the pace of innovation to continue to accelerate. We must continually introduce new and enhance existing solutions to retain customers and attract new customers. Developing new solutions is complex, requires significant investment and operational costs and may not be profitable, and our investments in new technologies are speculative and may not yield the expected business or financial benefits. The commercial success of new or enhanced solutions depends on a number of factors, including timely and successful development; effective distribution and marketing; market acceptance; compatibility with existing and emerging standards, platforms, software delivery methods and technologies; accurately predicting and anticipating customer needs and expectations and the direction of technological change; identifying and innovating in the right technologies; and differentiation from other solutions. If we fail to anticipate or identify technological, creative, productivity or marketing trends or fail to devote appropriate resources to adapt to such trends, our business could be harmed. For example, artificial intelligence ("AI"), including generative and agentic, enables users of all skill levels to create and provide new ways of marketing, creating and editing content and interacting with documents. While we continue to release new AI solutions and to focus on enhancing the AI capabilities of our solutions and incorporating AI across existing solutions, there can be no assurance that our new or enhanced solutions and AI innovations will be successful, adopted or monetizable or that we will innovate effectively to keep pace with the rapid evolution of AI across our solutions. If we do not successfully innovate, adapt to rapid technological or industry changes and meet customer needs, our business and our financial results may be materially harmed.

The markets for our solutions are rapidly evolving and intensely competitive. We expect competition to continue to intensify. Our numerous competitors include companies of various sizes and both public and private companies, including large, global companies and smaller companies with more specialized focuses, new entrants, and AI or cloud-native companies. Our competitors include companies with significant sales and research and development resources, broad brand awareness, long operating histories or access to large customer bases. Our competitors may deploy technical, marketing and financial resources more easily and effectively. Our competitors may develop or acquire additional products, services or solutions that are similar to ours or that achieve greater or faster acceptance. Our competitors may undertake faster and more far-reaching and successful development efforts or marketing campaigns, may adopt more aggressive pricing policies or may more effectively appeal to customers. As a result, current and potential customers may select the products, services or solutions of our competitors. New industry standards, evolving distribution and sales models, limited barriers to entry, short product life cycles, customer price sensitivity, global economic conditions and the frequent entry of new solutions or competitors may increase downward pressure on pricing and gross margins and adversely affect our renewal, upsell and cross-sell rates as well as our ability to attract new customers. In addition, we expect to face more competition as AI continues to advance and be integrated into the markets in which we compete and to change the software industry. Our competitors or other third parties may develop AI solutions more rapidly or successfully, including but not limited to different data training strategies or proprietary access to data and, as a result, other AI solutions may achieve greater and faster adoption. For example, we face increasing competition from companies offering generative and agentic AI solutions, including but not limited to prompt-based and multi-modal creation and editing, document productivity and understanding, ad distribution and creation, and purpose-built AI agents. Other companies have in the past, and may in the future prevent, limit or interfere with our ability to use third-party models in our solutions. If we are not able to provide solutions that compete effectively, we could experience reduced sales, which could materially and adversely impact our business and financial results. For additional information regarding our competition and the risks arising out of the competitive environment in which we operate, see the section titled "Competition" contained in Part I, Item 1 of this report.

Social, ethical and operational issues relating to the use of AI, including generative AI and agentic AI, in our solutions may result in reputational harm, liability and additional costs. We are increasingly incorporating AI technologies, developed by us and by third parties, into many of our solutions. If our AI development, deployment, content labeling or governance is ineffective or inadequate, it may result in incidents that impair the public acceptance of AI solutions or cause harm to individuals, customers or society, or result in our solutions not working as intended or producing unexpected outcomes.

Jurisdictions around the world are developing and passing new regulations that apply specifically to the use of AI. For example, the U.S. AI regulatory framework remains in development and has been introduced at the federal level through executive orders and legislation has been introduced and enacted at the state level. Additionally, obligations under the EU AI Act have gone into effect and will continue to be implemented in phases through 2030, and other jurisdictions have passed or are considering similarly focused legislation. Some of our operations are subject to the EU AI Act and depending on how the EU AI Act is implemented and interpreted, we may have to adapt our business practices, contractual arrangements and services to comply with such obligations. Non-compliant companies under the EU AI Act may be subject to administrative fines. These regulations and the evolving AI regulatory environment may, among other impacts, result in inconsistencies among AI regulations and frameworks across jurisdictions, increase our compliance, governance and research and development costs, increase our exposure to investigations, proceedings and claims related to our AI models and increase liability related to the use of AI by our customers or users that are beyond our control. There can be no guarantee that future AI regulations or standards will not adversely impact us or conflict with our approach to AI development and use, including affecting our ability to make our AI solutions available without costly changes, delaying or halting development of AI solutions, requiring us to change our AI development practices, monetization strategies and/or indemnity protections and subjecting us to additional compliance requirements, regulatory action, competitive harm, reputational harm and/or legal liability. Additionally, as we offer more third-party AI models in our solutions, we face risks inherent in how third-party AI models used in our solutions have been developed and deployed, including situations in which the third party may lack a proper license or consent for the training data used for their model. The use and availability of third-party AI models in our solutions could result in scrutiny and legal liability, including intellectual property infringement claims. Such claims or scrutiny could cause reputational harm and loss of customers, and adversely impact our business and financial results. In addition, new competition regulations on AI development and deployment could impose new requirements on our markets that could impact our business and financial results.

Uncertainty around new and evolving AI uses may require significant, additional investment to develop models and proprietary datasets, responsible-use frameworks and new approaches and processes to attribute or compensate content creators. We have experienced, and may in the future experience, challenges accessing AI models, datasets or hardware. Developing, testing and deploying AI systems and third-party AI models may continue to increase the cost of our solutions, including due to the nature of the computing costs involved in such systems. These costs could adversely impact our margins as we continue to make significant investments in AI development, add AI capabilities and third-party AI models to our solutions and scale our AI solutions without assurance that our customers and users will adopt them. Further, as with any new solutions based on new and rapidly evolving technologies, consumer reception and monetization pathways are uncertain, our strategies may not be successful and our business and financial results could be adversely impacted. AI solutions may continue to modify workforce needs, result in negative publicity, reputational harm, liability and decreased demand for our solutions, all of which could adversely impact our business.

For our fiscal 2025, we experienced strong demand across our Digital Media and Digital Experience offerings, driven by transformative and customer-focused product innovation. As we execute on our long-term growth initiatives, with emphasis on delivering value through AI-powered and highly differentiated solutions to meet the needs of our diverse and expanding customer base, we have continued to experience growth in software-based subscription revenue across our portfolio of offerings.

Our Digital Media products, services and solutions help users create, design and publish rich content and 3D experiences, and improve productivity by transforming how they view, share and collaborate on documents and content. These offerings include our Creative Cloud flagship applications ("apps") such as Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator, Adobe Lightroom, Adobe Premiere Pro and Adobe After Effects; as well as Adobe Acrobat, Adobe Express, Adobe Firefly and many more products, which are available across surfaces and platforms as desktop tools, web and mobile apps and cloud-based services. Adobe Express is our web and mobile app designed to enable a broad spectrum of users, including novice content creators and communicators, to create, edit and customize content quickly and easily with content first, task-based solutions. Our Adobe Acrobat offerings fuel document productivity, enabling users to create, collaborate, review, approve, sign and track documents at home, in the office and across devices. AI innovation is deeply infused into our Digital Media solutions, including through Adobe Firefly-powered generative AI features available across our Creative Cloud flagship apps, and through Acrobat AI Assistant, a generative AI-powered conversational interface designed to enhance document experiences. In August 2025, we released Acrobat Studio, which brings together Adobe Acrobat, Adobe Express and AI agents to further unite productivity and creativity, empowering users to quickly derive insights from their documents and create visually compelling content. Our Digital Media customers include business professionals, consumers, creative professionals, creators and marketing professionals.

During fiscal 2025, Annualized Recurring Revenue ("ARR") was the key performance metric our management used to assess the health and trajectory of our overall Digital Media segment. Digital Media ARR was calculated as the sum of the annual value of Digital Media subscriptions and services and the annual value of Digital Media Enterprise Term License Agreements.

Digital Media ARR grew to $19.20 billion at the end of fiscal 2025, representing 11.5% year-over-year growth. Our success in driving growth in ARR has positively affected our revenue growth. Digital Media segment revenue grew to $17.65 billion in fiscal 2025, up from $15.86 billion in fiscal 2024, representing 11% year-over-year growth.

Our Digital Experience apps and services are designed to accelerate customer experience orchestration at scale and supply intelligence for businesses of any size in any industry. Digital Experience is comprised of solutions to deliver actionable data, with products such as Adobe Analytics and Adobe Real-Time Customer Data Platform; optimize personalized content delivery, with products such as Adobe Experience Manager, Adobe Commerce and Adobe GenStudio for Performance Marketing; and manage customer journeys, with products such as Adobe Marketo Engage and Adobe Campaign. Our differentiation and competitive advantage are strengthened by our ability to use the Adobe Experience Platform to integrate our comprehensive set of solutions and our ability to embed AI into our product portfolio, such as with our Adobe Experience Platform AI Assistant, a generative AI-powered conversational interface designed to help customers automate workflows and generate new audiences and journeys. Our Digital Experience customers include marketing professionals such as brand managers, channel marketers and campaign strategists.

Digital Experience revenue was $5.86 billion in fiscal 2025, up from $5.37 billion in fiscal 2024, representing 9% year-over-year growth. Subscription revenue grew to $5.41 billion in fiscal 2025, up from $4.86 billion in fiscal 2024, representing 11% year-over-year growth.

Our customers often are involved in workflows that integrate multiple Adobe products across both segments. By combining the creativity of our Digital Media business with the science of our Digital Experience business, such as with our Adobe GenStudio solutions, we help our customers to more efficiently and effectively make, manage, measure and monetize their content across every channel with an end-to-end workflow.

Spanning both our Digital Media and Digital Experience segments, we drove continued business success through audience-specific product innovation and go-to-market strategy focused on the following two customer groups:

•Business Professionals & Consumers desire web and mobile apps with easy-to-use AI capabilities, and are increasingly benefiting from using Adobe Acrobat and Adobe Express. Revenue associated with the Business Professionals & Consumers customer group consists of Adobe Acrobat offerings and Adobe Express, all of which are part of Digital Media.

•Creative & Marketing Professionals require agile and comprehensive solutions to create high volumes of compelling content, infused with commercially safe AI capabilities; and are benefiting from investments in powerful, integrated workflows through offerings such as Adobe Firefly and Adobe GenStudio. Revenue associated with the Creative & Marketing Professionals customer group consists of Digital Experience offerings as well as Creative Cloud flagship apps such as Photoshop, Lightroom and Illustrator within Digital Media.
Due to the nature of certain offerings which contain cross-product integrations or benefits, revenue attributable to certain product entitlements may be recognized in either customer group.

paragraphs: Adobe 的使命是賦能所有人進行創作。我們建立創新平台與工具，釋放創意、生產力與個性化客戶體驗。在過去四十年多的時間裡，我們的創新已改變人們在所有類型媒體上的互動方式。Adobe 的解決方案是數位體驗的基礎，從最初的創意靈感，到內容與媒體的創造與發展，再到透過每一個通路進行個性化交付。

我們的重點圍繞服務我們的客戶羣：企業專業人士、消費者、創作者、創意專業人士與行銷專業人士。創意在不同角色與產業中的廣大機會與演變角色，已驅動 Adobe 在過去四十年的成長，並預期未來隨著我們演進解決方案與市場通路，持續推動成長。在人工智慧（"AI"）時代，我們透過整合我們商業上安全的自有第一方與領先合作夥伴的 AI 模型，來運用 AI 的力量；部署對話式與代理式功能於各項產品；確保在所有裝置上皆可使用；提供值得信賴且安全的解決方案；並擴展我們的全球佈局。
Adobe 的價值主張是，在多種媒體類型與通路中，於規模化、協作與安全的環境中，賦能創意表達。我們透過 Adobe 的 AI 平台，提供客戶品牌安全、合規、智慧財產權保護與可靠性，來驅動整個內容工作流程。

Adobe 的策略是賦能我們的客戶羣—企業專業人士、消費者、創作者、創意專業人士與行銷專業人士—使其更具創意、生產力與成功。我們以客戶為中心的解決方案背後，是我們的 AI 策略與 Adobe 的 AI 平台。作為一個釋放創意、生產力與客戶體驗協調的科技領導者，我們提供端到端的專業創意與行銷解決方案。我們支持客戶轉變他們與客戶互動的方式，並透過連接的工具、代理與工作流程，以新的強大方式將創意與行銷結合。
我們透過針對客戶的產品創新與市場通路策略來推動我們的策略，重點聚焦於兩個客戶羣：企業專業人士與消費者，以及創意與行銷專業人士。我們持續聚焦於我們客戶羣中的幾個關鍵
成長驅動因素。這包括擴展與現有客戶的關係與參與度，推動新客戶採用，於桌面、網頁與行動端的新類別中提供價值導向且創新解決方案，並增加我們的地理覆蓋範圍。我們持續擴展我們的數位與企業市場通路，以及我們廣泛的合作夥伴生態系，以擴大我們的可接觸市場並實現我們的策略。
創意與生產力正在融合，並改變人們如何數位溝通。企業專業人士與消費者尋求直覺、一體成形的解決方案，這些解決方案能順暢整合創意與生產力於網頁與行動端。他們需要工具來處理並從大量資訊與數據中獲得見解。他們重視易用性，這由 freemium 模式提供可接觸的入口點，以使用強大工具，這些工具涵蓋文件消費與內容創作。AI 驅動的功能與對話式介面正逐漸取代傳統模板，提供動態且個性化的流程，以提升效率。

對於企業專業人士與消費者，我們透過 AI 驅動、快速且易用的應用程式（"apps"），來民主化生產力與創意，使用戶無論是消費或產生內容，都能在多種媒體類型與通路中進行創意與生產力。透過 Acrobat Studio，將 Adobe Acrobat 與 Express 結合，以提供更高的產品價值，我們正在將 Acrobat 從一個領先的文件生產力應用程式，轉型為一個整合的終點，讓用戶更快獲得見解、創造突出的內容，並更順暢地協作。我們的 Acrobat 解決方案，從 freemium 的 Acrobat Reader 到 Acrobat AI Assistant，再到我們的 AI 驅動的生產力與創意終點 Acrobat Studio，有助於實現無摩擦的入門體驗與規模化的覆蓋，以服務這一羣客戶的十億潛在用戶。
創作者與創意專業人士需要以 AI 為驅動的解決方案，提供從概念發想、創作、生產到交付的強大且精準的工具。他們希望有一個強大的創作表達目的地，並能取得領先的 AI 模型。他們需要無縫的協作功能、強大的概念發想工具、對話式與自主型 AI 解決方案，以及靈活的網頁、行動與桌面應用程式存取方式，以應對快速發展的數位經濟中對高品質、個性化內容日益增長的需求。
隨著 AI 根本性地改變內容的製作、分發與商業化，我們的解決方案加速創作者與創意專業人士的創作表達，並讓任何人透過我們旗艦創意應用程式內嵌的 AI 功能以及我們以 AI 為先的解決方案來進行創作。我們提供一個端到端、從概念發想到創作的平台，由我們商業安全的 Firefly 模型驅動，並結合廣泛的夥伴模型生態系統，為客戶提供選擇與靈活性，而不必在工作流程與平台之間切換所產生的摩擦。
市場營銷專業人士需要以 AI 為驅動的解決方案，讓他們能大規模地創造、管理與優化個性化數位體驗，並提升品牌在內容供應鏈中的可見度。他們需要靈活性、自服務功能與整合的工作流程，以有效與創意團隊與代理商協作，並應對對強大內容日益增長的需求。

對於市場營銷專業人士，我們透過全面的內容供應鏈解決方案，將創意製作與市場執行統一，提供端到端的客戶體驗 orchestrating 解決方案，自動化工作流程，並在各個通路中大規模個性化體驗與互動。以 Adobe Experience Platform 及其應用程式與 Adobe GenStudio 為核心，我們的產品線簡化了內容供應鏈，並提供靈活的自服務功能與整合的工作流程，以有效且高效地產生大量符合品牌標準、個性化的內容，進而強化品牌可見度。我們的競爭優勢來自於透過整合 Adobe Experience Platform 與我們全面的解決方案組合，並將 AI 結合至我們的解決方案組閤中，例如 Adobe Experience Platform AI Assistant 所提供的更高價值。Adobe Experience Platform 是一個客戶資料平台，作為企業在數位客戶互動的基礎，並整合 AI 驅動的應用程式與代理，以高效地推動互動與忠誠度。透過 AI 驅動的功能與 AI 代理，我們的解決方案使企業能提供客戶旅程的即時 orchestrating，並協助行銷人員執行有影響力、數據驅動的行銷活動，同時優化投資回報率。我們的創新使客戶能運用其第一方客戶資料，並提供更相關、高影響力的廣告體驗，這些體驗根植於直接的消費者與企業關係。

創作者與市場營銷專業人士在內容生命週期中越來越相互連結的目標與工作流程。創作者產生高品質的內容，而市場營銷專業人士則利用這些內容，大規模地提供個性化、數據驅動的數位體驗。Adobe 的整合解決方案，例如 GenStudio 與 Firefly Services，橋接了內容創作與市場執行之間的差距，使這些角色之間能實現無縫的協作與效率。這種統一的方法反映了 Adobe 的策略，以應對整個內容生命週期—from 概念發想到執行—確保創作者與市場營銷功能之間的協調、可擴展性與價值。

AI 代表了一個世代性的機會，以服務日益龐大且多樣化的客戶羣。Adobe 對 AI 的方法建立在相信創意是一種獨特的人類特質—並認為 AI 有力量協助與放大人類的創造力，並提升生產力。Adobe 的 AI 領先地位建立在我們在影像、設計、插圖與影片等核心創意類別，以及數位文件與數位體驗方面的專業知識之上。在過去幾年，我們已將 AI 納入解決方案中，並推出了數百種 AI 功能，以協助客戶更高效地進行創作、工作與協作。為回應客戶對整合其生產力、創意與行銷需求的整體方法的需求，Adobe 的策略是將 AI 融入我們的應用程式中，於應用程式中嵌入專為設計的代理，提供模型選擇的靈活性，並利用我們獨特的資料資產，以提供全面且易於使用的解決方案。

paragraphs: 於我們的財務年度 2025，我們在數位媒體與數位體驗業務領域觀察到強勁的銷售需求，這是由於具創新性且以客戶為導向的產品創新所驅動。在執行我們的長期成長策略時，我們特別著重於透過 AI 驅動且高度差異化的解決方案，以滿足我們多樣化且不斷擴張的客戶羣體的需要，因此我們持續在產品組閤中觀察到基於軟體的訂閱收入成長。

我們的數位媒體產品、服務與解決方案協助用戶創造、設計與發佈豐富的內容與 3D 經驗，並透過改變用戶觀看、分享與協作文件與內容的方式來提升生產力。這些業務包括我們的 Creative Cloud 頭銜應用程式（"應用程式"）如 Adobe Photoshop、Adobe Illustrator、Adobe Lightroom、Adobe Premiere Pro 與 Adobe After Effects；以及 Adobe Acrobat、Adobe Express、Adobe Firefly 與許多其他產品，這些產品可在桌面工具、網頁與行動應用程式以及雲端服務中使用。Adobe Express 是我們的網頁與行動應用程式，設計用以讓廣泛的用戶羣體，包括初學者內容創作者與溝通者，能快速且輕鬆地創造、編輯與客製化內容，並透過以內容為先、以任務為導向的解決方案。我們的 Adobe Acrobat 解決方案提升文件生產力，使用戶能在家中、辦公室與多種裝置上建立、協作、審閱、批准、簽署與追蹤文件。AI 創新已深度融入我們的數位媒體解決方案，包括透過 Adobe Firefly 驅動的生成式 AI 功能，可在我們的 Creative Cloud 頭銜應用程式中使用，以及透過 Acrobat AI 助手，一種生成式 AI 驅動的對話式介面，設計用以增強文件體驗。於 2025 年 8 月，我們發佈 Acrobat Studio，將 Adobe Acrobat、Adobe Express 與 AI 代理整合在一起，進一步結合生產力與創意，使用戶能快速從文件中獲得見解並創造視覺上吸引人的內容。我們的數位媒體客戶包括企業專業人士、消費者、創意專業人士、內容創作者與市場專業人士。
於財務年度 2025，年度經常性收入（"ARR"）是我們管理層用來評估我們整體數位媒體業務健康狀況與發展趨勢的關鍵績效指標。數位媒體 ARR 計算為數位媒體訂閱與服務的年度價值與數位媒體企業長期授權協議的年度價值總和。
數位媒體 ARR 在財務年度 2025 終了時成長至 192 億美元，較前一年成長 11.5%。我們在推動 ARR 成長方面的成功已正面影響我們的營業收入成長。數位媒體業務的營業收入在財務年度 2025 成長至 176.5 億美元，較財務年度 2024 的 158.6 億美元成長 11%。

我們的數位體驗應用程式與服務設計用以加速大規模的客戶體驗協調與供應鏈智慧，適用於任何規模與產業的企業。數位體驗由提供可操作數據的解決方案組成，包括 Adobe Analytics 與 Adobe Real-Time Customer Data Platform；優化個性化內容交付，包括 Adobe Experience Manager、Adobe Commerce 與 Adobe GenStudio for Performance Marketing；以及管理客戶旅程，包括 Adobe Marketo Engage 與 Adobe Campaign。我們的差異化與競爭優勢因我們能運用 Adobe Experience Platform 整合我們全面的解決方案，以及將 AI 嵌入產品組合的能力而加強，例如透過 Adobe Experience Platform AI Assistant，一種生成式 AI 驅動的對話式介面，設計用以協助客戶自動化工作流程並產生新觀眾與旅程。我們的數位體驗客戶包括市場專業人士，如品牌經理、渠道行銷人員與活動策略師。
數位體驗營業收入在財務年度 2025 為 58.6 億美元，較財務年度 2024 的 53.7 億美元成長 9%，訂閱收入成長至 54.1 億美元，較財務年度 2024 的 48.6 億美元成長 11%。
我們的客戶經常參與整合多種 Adobe 產品的作業流程，橫跨兩個業務領域。透過結合我們數位媒體業務的創意與數位體驗業務的科學，例如透過 Adobe GenStudio 解決方案，我們協助客戶更有效率且更有效地在每一個通路中建立、管理、衡量與賺取內容，並透過完整的作業流程。
橫跨我們的數位媒體與數位體驗業務領域，我們透過針對以下兩羣客戶的產品創新與市場策略，持續推動業務成功：
•商業專業人士與消費者期望具備易用性的人工智慧功能的網頁與行動應用程式，並 increasingly 從使用 Adobe Acrobat 和 Adobe Express 中受益。與商業專業人士與消費者客戶羣相關的收入包含 Adobe Acrobat 產品與 Adobe Express，所有這些產品均為數位媒體（Digital Media）的一部分。

•創意與行銷專業人士需要敏捷且完整的解決方案，以產生大量有吸引力的內容，並融入商業安全的人工智慧功能；並從對強大且整合的作業流程的投資中受益，例如 Adobe Firefly 和 Adobe GenStudio。與創意與行銷專業人士客戶羣相關的收入包含數位體驗（Digital Experience）產品，以及如 Photoshop、Lightroom 和 Illustrator 等屬於數位媒體（Digital Media）的 Creative Cloud 頭部應用程式。
由於某些產品包含跨產品整合或效益，因此某些產品權限所產生的收入可能被歸屬於任一客戶羣。

headings: 與我們拓展業務能力相關的風險
我們可能無法在快速技術或產業變革中創新以符合客戶需求，這可能會導致我們的業務與財務結果受到重大影響。
我們參與快速演進且競爭激烈的市場，若我們無法有效競爭，可能會導致我們的業務與財務結果受到重大影響。
與我們解決方案中人工智能（AI）的開發與使用相關的問題，可能會導致聲譽損害、責任及不利的業務與財務結果。
若我們的聲譽或品牌受到損害，可能會對我們的業務與財務結果產生不利影響。
我們可能無法實現收購、投資或其他戰略交易預期的效益，這些交易可能會干擾我們的業務，並對我們的業務與財務結果產生不利影響。
與我們業務運作相關的風險
若我們無法招募與留任關鍵人才，可能會對我們的業務造成損害，且我們的混合工作模式可能帶來挑戰，這可能會對我們的業務產生不利影響。
資訊安全事件、不當取得或揭露客戶資料或其他資訊安全事件，可能損害本公司聲譽，並對本公司業務造成重大且不利的影響。
本公司作為跨國企業營運，面臨多種風險，且全球不利的經濟與地緣政治條件可能損害本公司業務與財務狀況。
部分企業解決方案具有延長且複雜的銷售週期，可能增加本公司成本，並使銷售週期難以預測。
與法律及法規相關的風險
本公司需遵守全球各國法律及法規，此等遵守義務可能對本公司業務造成風險。
對隱私權與安全議題的監管關注度持續增加，以及法規與監管要求的擴張，可能影響本公司業務模式，並使本公司面臨更高的法律責任風險。
智慧財產權組合為本公司重要資產，本公司可能無法有效保護智慧財產權權利，包括來源程式碼，免於侵權、未經授權的複製、使用或揭露。
稅務規則與法規的變更或其解釋方式的改變，可能對本公司有效稅率造成不利影響。
與政府機構簽訂契約使我們面臨政府採購程序中固有的額外風險。
與財務表現相關的風險
paragraphs: 如前所述，我們實際的結果可能與我們的展望性陳述有重大差異。以下我們討論一些可能導致這些差異的因素。這些以及本報告中描述的許多其他因素，以及我們目前未知或認為不重要的因素，可能會對我們的營運、表現與財務狀況造成重大且不利的影響。許多因素影響多於一個類別，且這些因素並未按重要性或發生機率排序，因為它們已按類別分組。

我們所處的產業快速演進，我們預期創新速度將持續加快。我們必須不斷推出新產品並提升現有解決方案，以留住客戶並吸引新客戶。開發新解決方案複雜，需要大量投資與營運成本，且可能無法獲利，我們對新技術的投資屬風險性質，可能無法產生預期的業務或財務效益。新或增強解決方案的商業成功取決於多種因素，包括及時且成功的開發；有效的分銷與行銷；市場接受度；與現有及新興標準、平台、軟體交付方式與技術的相容性；準確預測與 anticipating 客戶需求與期望以及技術變革的趨勢；識別並創新正確的技術；以及與其他解決方案的差異化。若我們未能預見或識別技術、創意、生產力或行銷趨勢，或未能投入適當資源適應這些趨勢，我們的業務可能會受到損害。例如，人工智慧（"AI"），包括生成式與代理式，使各層次技能的使用者都能創造並提供新的行銷方式、創造與編輯內容及與文件互動的方式。雖然我們持續推出新 AI 解決方案，並專注於增強我們解決方案的 AI 能力，並將 AI 整合至現有解決方案中，但無法保證我們的新或增強解決方案與 AI 創新會成功、被採用或可商業化，或我們能有效創新以跟上 AI 在我們解決方案中快速演進的趨勢。若我們未能成功創新、適應快速的技術或產業變革並滿足客戶需求，我們的業務與財務結果可能會受到重大損害。

我們解決方案的市場快速演進且競爭激烈。我們預期競爭將持續加劇。我們的眾多競爭對手包括不同規模的公司，以及上市與未上市的公司，包括大型全球公司與較小且專注於特定領域的公司、新進企業，以及 AI 或雲端原生公司。我們的競爭對手包括擁有大量銷售與研究與開發資源、廣泛品牌認知度、長期營運歷史或大量客戶基礎的公司。競爭對手可能更容易且更有效地部署技術、行銷與財務資源。競爭對手可能開發或取得與我們相似或更受歡迎或更快被接受的產品、服務或解決方案。競爭對手可能進行更快且更廣泛且成功的開發努力或行銷活動，可能採用更積極的定價政策，或更有效地吸引客戶。因此，現有與潛在客戶可能選擇競爭對手的產品、服務或解決方案。新產業標準、演進的分銷與銷售模式、有限的進入門檻、短產品生命週期、客戶價格敏感度、全球經濟條件以及新解決方案或競爭對手的頻繁進入，可能會增加價格壓力與毛利率的下行壓力，並對我們的續約、 upsell 與 cross-sell 率以及吸引新客戶的能力產生不利影響。此外，我們預期隨著 AI 繼續進步並被整合至我們競爭的市場中，並改變軟體產業，將面臨更多競爭。競爭對手或其他第三方可能更快或更成功地開發 AI 解決方案，包括但不限於不同的資料訓練策略或專屬資料存取權，因此其他 AI 解決方案可能實現更快且更廣泛的採用。例如，我們面臨來自提供生成式與代理式 AI 解決方案公司的日益增加的競爭，包括但不限於基於提示的多模式創造與編輯、文件生產力與理解、廣告分佈與創造，以及專門設計的 AI 代理。其他公司過去曾且可能未來會阻止、限制或幹擾我們使用第三方模型在解決方案中的能力。若我們無法提供有效的競爭解決方案，我們可能會經歷銷售減少，這可能會對我們的業務與財務結果造成重大且不利的影響。如需有關我們競爭與我們所處競爭環境中產生的風險的更多資訊，請參閱本報告第一部分第 1 項標題為 "競爭" 的部分。

與我們解決方案中使用人工智慧（包括生成式 AI 與代理式 AI）相關的社會、倫理與作業問題，可能會導致聲譽損害、責任與額外成本。我們正 increasingly 將由我們與第三方開發的人工智慧技術整合至許多解決方案中。若我們的人工智慧開發、部署、內容標籤或治理不夠有效或不足，可能會導致事件影響公眾對人工智慧解決方案的接受度，或對個人、客戶或社會造成損害，或導致我們的解決方案無法如預期運作或產生意外結果。

全球各司法管轄區正在制定並通過針對人工智慧使用的特定規範。例如，美國的人工智慧規範框架仍處於發展階段，已透過行政命令在聯邦層面引入，並在州層面引入並通過了相關立法。此外，歐盟人工智慧法案（EU AI Act）的義務已生效，並將在 2030 年前分階段實施，其他司法管轄區已通過或正在考慮類似的立法。我們的一些業務活動受歐盟人工智慧法案（EU AI Act）規範，根據歐盟人工智慧法案（EU AI Act）的實施與解釋方式，我們可能需要調整業務作法、契約安排與服務以符合這些義務。未遵守歐盟人工智慧法案（EU AI Act）的公司可能面臨行政罰款。這些規範與不斷演進的人工智慧規範環境，可能導致跨司法管轄區的人工智慧規範與框架不一致，增加我們的合規、治理與研究與開發成本，增加我們對與我們人工智慧模型相關的調查、程序與聲請的暴露風險，並增加我們客戶或使用者使用人工智慧的責任，而這些責任超出我們的控制範疇。無法保證未來的人工智慧規範或標準不會對我們造成不利影響，或與我們的人工智慧開發與使用方法產生衝突，包括影響我們在不進行成本高昂變更的情況下提供人工智慧解決方案的能力，延遲或中止人工智慧解決方案的開發，要求我們改變人工智慧開發作法、商業化策略與/或賠償保護，並使我們面臨額外的合規要求、監管行動、競爭損害、聲譽損害與/或法律責任。此外，隨著我們在解決方案中提供更多第三方人工智慧模型，我們面臨使用這些第三方人工智慧模型的風險，包括第三方可能缺乏適當授權或同意用於其模型的訓練資料的情況。我們解決方案中使用與可用的第三方人工智慧模型，可能導致審查與法律責任，包括智慧財產權侵權聲請。這些聲請或審查可能導致聲譽損害與客戶流失，並對我們的業務與財務結果產生不利影響。此外，針對人工智慧開發與部署的新競爭法規，可能對我們的市場施加新要求，這可能會影響我們的業務與財務結果。

關於新興與演進中的人工智慧用途的不確定性，可能需要進行大量額外投資以開發模型與專屬資料集、負責任使用框架以及新的方法與流程以歸屬或補償內容創作者。我們已經驗過，且可能未來也會經驗到，取得人工智慧模型、資料集或硬體的困難。開發、測試與部署人工智慧系統與第三方人工智慧模型，可能會持續增加我們解決方案的成本，包括因這些系統涉及的計算成本性質所致。這些成本可能對我們的毛利率造成不利影響，因為我們持續在人工智慧開發上進行大量投資，將人工智慧功能與第三方人工智慧模型加入解決方案中，並擴展人工智慧解決方案，而無法保證客戶與使用者會採用這些解決方案。此外，如同任何基於新興且快速演進技術的新解決方案，消費者接受度與商業化途徑存在不確定性，我們的策略可能無法成功，並對我們的業務與財務結果造成不利影響。人工智慧解決方案可能持續改變人力需求，導致負面宣傳、聲譽損害、責任與對我們解決方案需求的減少，所有這些都可能對我們的業務造成不利影響。
